verdict.rationale: Graphite is a developer-platform SaaS with a CLI and MCP server, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a versioned public API or any deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Mentions of CLI version numbers (e.g., gt 1.8.4) are an adjacent detail, not an API versioning or deprecation commitment.
